user_story:
As a user, I want to log in to my account using my email and password so that I can access my personal information and order history.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. The user must see the heading 'Login to your account' on the login page.
2. The user must be able to enter their email in the input field with the placeholder 'Email Address' (selector: 'input[name="email"]').
3. The user must be able to enter their password in the input field with the placeholder 'Password' (selector: 'input[name="password"]').
4. The user must see a 'Login' button (selector: 'button[class="btn btn-default"]' with text 'Login').
5. Upon successful login, the user must be redirected to the homepage (URL: 'https://automationexercise.com/').
